non_blocking_issues.issue: 'Godot alone read 21-54 % during p2's setup and docked control, which argues for an external holder' (finding 1; same figure in the Risks sampler bullet) is not supported. In p2.gpu every pre-T sample with the runner under 5 % CPU (7 samples) reads GPU 0-1 %; the 21-54 % samples all have the runner at 20-42 % CPU, and the pre-T samples at 85-97 % have the runner at 32-60 %. So the sampler never observed Godot alone at 21-54 %. The inference (external holder, probably the runner) is still reasonable, and is in fact better supported by 85-97 % with runner 32-60 % than by the sentence given.
